_comment: Model ladder for the public site, pinned by Hugging Face repo revision and file sha256 (from the HF API, blobs=true, on 2026-09-04). A lens id is frozen forever once texts carry it. The memory64 build loads single files of any size straight from the Hub (the 2.5 GB 4B file was verified 2026-09-04); the wasm32 compat build (Safari) is limited to 2 GB per file, so rungs marked memory64 are not offered there. carrierRate sizes the token budget, see each rung's note.

engine.name: llama.cpp-wasm (wllama fork)
engine._comment: the engine build is part of a lens fingerprint; scripts/fetch-engine.mjs downloads these assets from the release and verifies them

rungs._carrierRateNote: fraction of generated tokens above the tau 2.0 gate at temperature 0.7; 0.6B measured 0.312 on 2026-09-04, set conservatively; others are placeholders until Phase 3
rungs._tauNote: entropy gate in nats; bigger models are more confident, so the gate is per rung and tuned from web/data/entropy.json (Phase 3)
rungs._tokPerSecNote: single-step CPU tokens per second on a 4-core laptop (2026-09-05 campaign; 8B extrapolated), for the ETA shown before a run
rungs._tagCapNote: 8 bytes everywhere: at the measured carrier rates on an open prompt a 127-bit lean frame is a few hundred tokens; the page shows the ETA before a run
